## VideoAbuseReportReason

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

The property and its value will be present if the broadcast has current viewers and the broadcast owner has not hidden the viewcount for the video. Note that YouTube stops tracking the number of concurrent viewers for a broadcast when the broadcast ends. Details about the content of a YouTube Video. This is a subset of the information in VideoContentDetails specifically for the Videos.stats API.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `duration` | `string` | No | No | Output only. The length of the video. The property value is a [`google.protobuf.Duration`](https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/reference/google.protobuf#duration) object. |
| `durationMillis` | `durationMillis` | `string` | No | No | — |

## VideoStatsSnippet

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

Basic details about a video. This is a subset of the information in VideoSnippet specifically for the Videos.stats API.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `publishTime` | `publishTime` | `string` | No | No | Output only. The date and time that the video was uploaded. The property value is a [`google.protobuf.Timestamp`](https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/reference/google.protobuf#timestamp) object. |

## VideoStatsStatistics

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

Statistics about the video, such as the number of times the video was viewed or liked.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `commentCount` | `commentCount` | `string` | No | No | Output only. The number of comments for the video. |
| `likeCount` | `likeCount` | `string` | No | No | Output only. The number of users who have indicated that they liked the video by giving it a positive rating. |
| `viewCount` | `viewCount` | `string` | No | No | Output only. The number of times the video has been viewed. |

## VideoStatus

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

Basic details about a video category, such as its localized title. Next Id: 19

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `containsSyntheticMedia` | `containsSyntheticMedia` | `boolean` | No | No | Indicates if the video contains altered or synthetic media. |
| `embeddable` | `embeddable` | `boolean` | No | No | This value indicates if the video can be embedded on another website. @mutable youtube.videos.insert youtube.videos.update |
| `failureReason` | `failureReason` | `"conversion" \| "invalidFile" \| "emptyFile" \| "tooSmall" \| "codec" \| "uploadAborted"` | No | No | This value explains why a video failed to upload. This property is only present if the uploadStatus property indicates that the upload failed. |
| `license` | `license` | `"youtube" \| "creativeCommon"` | No | No | The video's license. @mutable youtube.videos.insert youtube.videos.update |
| `madeForKids` | `madeForKids` | `boolean` | No | No | — |
| `privacyStatus` | `privacyStatus` | `"public" \| "unlisted" \| "private"` | No | No | The video's privacy status. |
| `publicStatsViewable` | `publicStatsViewable` | `boolean` | No | No | This value indicates if the extended video statistics on the watch page can be viewed by everyone. Note that the view count, likes, etc will still be visible if this is disabled. @mutable youtube.videos.insert youtube.videos.update |
| `publishAt` | `publishAt` | `string<date-time>` | No | No | The date and time when the video is scheduled to publish. It can be set only if the privacy status of the video is private.. |
| `rejectionReason` | `rejectionReason` | `"copyright" \| "inappropriate" \| "duplicate" \| "termsOfUse" \| "uploaderAccountSuspended" \| "length" \| "claim" \| "uploaderAccountClosed" \| "trademark" \| "legal"` | No | No | This value explains why YouTube rejected an uploaded video. This property is only present if the uploadStatus property indicates that the upload was rejected. |
| `selfDeclaredMadeForKids` | `selfDeclaredMadeForKids` | `boolean` | No | No | — |
| `uploadStatus` | `uploadStatus` | `"uploaded" \| "processed" \| "failed" \| "rejected" \| "deleted"` | No | No | The status of the uploaded video. |

## VideoSuggestions

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

Specifies suggestions on how to improve video content, including encoding hints, tag suggestions, and editor suggestions.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `editorSuggestions` | `editorSuggestions` | `Array<"videoAutoLevels" \| "videoStabilize" \| "videoCrop" \| "audioQuietAudioSwap">` | No | No | A list of video editing operations that might improve the video quality or playback experience of the uploaded video. |
| `processingErrors` | `processingErrors` | `Array<"audioFile" \| "imageFile" \| "projectFile" \| "notAVideoFile" \| "docFile" \| "archiveFile" \| "unsupportedSpatialAudioLayout">` | No | No | A list of errors that will prevent YouTube from successfully processing the uploaded video video. These errors indicate that, regardless of the video's current processing status, eventually, that status will almost certainly be failed. |
| `processingHints` | `processingHints` | `Array<"nonStreamableMov" \| "sendBestQualityVideo" \| "sphericalVideo" \| "spatialAudio" \| "vrVideo" \| "hdrVideo">` | No | No | A list of suggestions that may improve YouTube's ability to process the video. |
| `processingWarnings` | `processingWarnings` | `Array<"unknownContainer" \| "unknownVideoCodec" \| "unknownAudioCodec" \| "inconsistentResolution" \| "hasEditlist" \| "problematicVideoCodec" \| "problematicAudioCodec" \| "unsupportedVrStereoMode" \| "unsupportedSphericalProjectionType" \| "unsupportedHdrPixelFormat" \| "unsupportedHdrColorMetadata" \| "problematicHdrLookupTable">` | No | No | A list of reasons why YouTube may have difficulty transcoding the uploaded video or that might result in an erroneous transcoding. These warnings are generated before YouTube actually processes the uploaded video file. In addition, they identify issues that are unlikely to cause the video processing to fail but that might cause problems such as sync issues, video artifacts, or a missing audio track. |
| `tagSuggestions` | `tagSuggestions` | `Array<VideoSuggestionsTagSuggestion>` | No | No | A list of keyword tags that could be added to the video's metadata to increase the likelihood that users will locate your video when searching or browsing on YouTube. |

## VideoSuggestionsTagSuggestion

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

A single tag suggestion with its relevance information.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `categoryRestricts` | `categoryRestricts` | `Array<string>` | No | No | A set of video categories for which the tag is relevant. You can use this information to display appropriate tag suggestions based on the video category that the video uploader associates with the video. By default, tag suggestions are relevant for all categories if there are no restricts defined for the keyword. |
| `tag` | `tag` | `string` | No | No | The keyword tag suggested for the video. |

## VideoTopicDetails

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

Freebase topic information related to the video.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `relevantTopicIds` | `relevantTopicIds` | `Array<string>` | No | No | Similar to topic_id, except that these topics are merely relevant to the video. These are topics that may be mentioned in, or appear in the video. You can retrieve information about each topic using Freebase Topic API. |
| `topicCategories` | `topicCategories` | `Array<string>` | No | No | A list of Wikipedia URLs that provide a high-level description of the video's content. |
| `topicIds` | `topicIds` | `Array<string>` | No | No | A list of Freebase topic IDs that are centrally associated with the video. These are topics that are centrally featured in the video, and it can be said that the video is mainly about each of these. You can retrieve information about each topic using the &lt; a href="http://wiki.freebase.com/wiki/Topic_API"&gt;Freebase Topic API. |

## VideoTrainability

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

Specifies who is allowed to train on the video.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `etag` | `etag` | `string` | No | No | Etag of this resource. |
| `kind` | `kind` | `string` | No | No | Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string "youtube#videoTrainability". |
| `permitted` | `permitted` | `Array<string>` | No | No | Specifies who is allowed to train on the video. Valid values are: - a single string "all" - a single string "none" - a list of allowed parties |
| `videoId` | `videoId` | `string` | No | No | The ID of the video. |

## WatchSettings

`object` model on the `json` wire format.

Branding properties for the watch. All deprecated.

| Field | Wire name | Type | Required | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `backgroundColor` | `backgroundColor` | `string` | No | No | The text color for the video watch page's branded area. |
| `featuredPlaylistId` | `featuredPlaylistId` | `string` | No | No | An ID that uniquely identifies a playlist that displays next to the video player. |
| `textColor` | `textColor` | `string` | No | No | The background color for the video watch page's branded area. |
